title: catalog.quote_status_changed v1
description: Emitted by alebrije-mod-catalog-go every time a catalog.quotes row moves through its lifecycle (draft->sent->confirmed->paid) — OutboxPublisher.EmitQuoteStatusChanged (internal/service/outbox_publisher.go, outboxQuoteStatusPayload), called by emitQuoteStatusChanged (quote_lifecycle.go) in the SAME tx as the successful QuotesRepo.Transition, from QuoteLifecycleService (MarkSent/ConfirmQuote/MarkQuotePaid) and PaymentOffersService (CreateOffer's draft->sent->confirmed, MarkPaid's confirmed->paid). One event per transition: the outbox idempotency key is '<event_type>:<quote_id>:<status>'. 'expired' is NEVER emitted — expiry is computed lazily (effectiveQuoteStatus); consumers derive it from valid_until. Carries no phone (catalog.quotes has none): consumers tie the move to the contact through the catalog.quote_created event of the same quote_id. Stream/event_type default 'catalog.quote_status_changed' (config.go StreamQuoteStatusChanged, env EVENTBUS_STREAM_CATALOG_QUOTE_STATUS_CHANGED); outbox-only, so fields travel nested under the envelope's `data`. First consumer: alebrije-mod-crm-go TimelineConsumer (C11 episode marks: sent/confirmed = avance, paid = fin).

quote_id.description: UUID of the catalog.quotes row that moved (q.ID.String()).

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant (q.TenantID.String()), redundant with the envelope-level tenant_id, same convention as catalog.quote_created.

context_id.description: Sucursal/branch dimension the quote was generated under (q.ContextID); may be an empty string, always present.

contact_id.description: The quote's contact id as stored on catalog.quotes (q.ContactID), or an empty string when the quote has none. It is the caller-side (omnichannel) contact id, not a crm.contacts id.

status.description: The NEW status the transition wrote (the row QuotesRepo.Transition RETURNED).

payment_choice.description: Present once the quote was confirmed with a stated payment intent (q.PaymentChoice).

total.description: Pre-tax total as a Money string (q.Total).

valid_until.description: created_at + the validity window the transition itself evaluated — the instant the quote lapses if it never reaches 'paid'.

occurred_at.description: UTC time the payload was built, RFC3339 with nanoseconds: CreateOffer writes sent and confirmed in one tx (same created_at), and this field keeps their real order.
